text:
DJIA Market Happenings For Wednesday, November 14, 2018 Posted by admin on November 14th, 2018
Dow stocks at 52 week highs include Procter & Gamble (PG). Dow stock 52 week lows include Goldman Sachs (GS).
The Market
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open up +97 points.
Tuesday the Dow was down -100.69 (-0.40%) at 25,286.49.
Year-to-date the Dow is up +2.29%.
There were 10 Dow stocks up Tuesday.
The Dow stock winners Tuesday were led by Intel (INTC) +1.595, American Express (AXP) +1.29% and Procter & Gamble (PG) +0.83%.
The Dow stock losers Tuesday were led by Exxon Mobil (XOM) -2.29%, Boeing (BA) -2.11% and Chevron (CVX) -1.74%.
3M (MMM +0.67%) may move higher initially this morning after its board authorized the repurchase of up to $10 billion of the company’s outstanding common stock.
European stocks are mostly higher and Asian markets ended mostly lower.
The national average price of gasoline is down nine-tenths of a cent at $2.677 per gallon.
